name: Rive Gauche Stroll
why: The olive henley lights up warm olive skin while the navy wool coat over black barrel jeans and suede Chelsea boots keeps the October evening sleek and tonal.
avoid: Optic white, sneakers, second metal piece

name: Café Noir
why: A black lace-up knit polo tucked into pleated black trousers gets warmth from dark-brown derbies and a braided belt under the ecru jacket — quiet luxury for a wine-bar date.
avoid: Bright accents, chunky sneakers

name: Marais Table for Two
why: Crinkled ecru linen softens the black textured blazer and balloon trousers, with penny loafers and a silver plaque necklace for an effortless candlelit finish.
avoid: Adding a belt (trousers include one), optic white shirt
stylist_note: Kimi visual check: MODIFY — demi-tuck the shirt, sleeves pushed, collar open; the balloon volume + untucked shirt swallows your frame. Gold-tone metal + cognac leather bridging.

name: Chocolate & Charcoal
why: A chocolate slim shirt against the charcoal pinstripe blazer-and-trouser set is peak deep-autumn, grounded by dark-brown oxfords and a matching braided belt.
avoid: Black footwear, cool grey shirt

name: Suitsupply Standard
why: The black Suitsupply suit with an off-white striped shirt — kinder to warm olive skin than optic white — plus black derbies and dress belt is boardroom-clean.
avoid: Optic white dress shirt, brown belt

name: Grey Marl Monday
why: An ecru cotton-linen polo relaxes the grey marl suit while the dark-brown derby and braided belt keep the palette warm and office-polished.
avoid: Black-on-black, tie-level formality

name: Noir Crochet
why: The black crochet shirt breathes on the dancefloor, and grey wide jeans with a bomber, Chelsea boots and layered silver chains keep it dark and textural.
avoid: Suit pieces, brown leather

name: Studded Indigo
why: A washed charcoal tank under the black denim overshirt lets the studded dark-indigo jeans do the talking, finished with Chelsea boots and a silver plaque.
avoid: Dress trousers, loafers

name: Canal Saint-Martin
why: A washed-green tee with light-blue cropped jeans under the blue denim jacket is tonal double-denim done right, the olive belt echoing the tee for a two-tone-plus-black stroll.
avoid: Same-wash indigo jacket, optic white

name: Riverside Cream
why: The cream athletics tee and ecru jacket read as one warm neutral over straight blue jeans, with a brown derby and studded belt adding autumn depth.
avoid: Black boots, navy layers

name: Gallery Opening
why: Détricoté off-white jacquard under the black textured blazer with pleated trousers and dark-brown oxfords is art-world sharp without resorting to a full suit.
avoid: Denim, graphic tees

name: Palais Cocktail
why: The ecru kimono-stripe jacquard is the statement, framed by black balloon trousers, black derbies and the navy wool coat for a strict three-tone October arrival.
avoid: Necklace over jacquard, brown shoes

name: Le Rendez-vous Gris
why: Washed grey print reads soft and warm on deep-autumn skin; indigo + dark-brown derby ground the palette.
avoid: Avoid black shoes — brown keeps the grey warm, not washed out.
stylist_note: Kimi visual check: MODIFY — silhouettes right, but washed grey reads cool on deep autumn; half-tuck + cognac belt + gold chain to warm it.

name: Crochet Café
why: Ecru crochet texture is made for deep autumn; relaxed indigo and brown derby keep it effortless.
avoid: Avoid layering over the crochet — the texture is the statement.

name: Jacquard au Bureau
why: Charcoal pinstripe blazer mutes the white check; black trousers and derbies keep it sharp and deep.
avoid: Avoid the white shirt solo near face — jacquard texture helps, but keep the blazer on.

name: Forêt d'Automne
why: Dark-brown check is peak deep autumn; ecru jacket + indigo makes a warm 3-color harmony.
avoid: Avoid black outerwear — it flattens the brown.

name: Nuit Blanche
why: White tank pops under the black bomber; monochrome with chelsea boots is the Parisian club uniform.
avoid: Avoid the tank alone — stark white near face; keep the bomber on.

name: Week-end Brocante
why: Brown check against distressed indigo and blue denim jacket; brown derby ties the warm tones together.
avoid: Avoid a third brown piece — the jacket stays blue for contrast.

name: Denim Clair Ancré
why: Light-blue quarter-zip freshened by white trousers; black chelsea boots anchor it for autumn.
avoid: Avoid pastel pairings — light blue must sit against deep neutrals only.

name: Tout Noir
why: Deconstructed black overshirt + black trousers + loafers: texture-driven monochrome, pure Paris night.
avoid: Avoid adding any color — this look lives on silhouette and texture.

name: Lin au Crépuscule
why: Ecru linen flatters warm deep-autumn tones; white trousers and brown oxfords keep it soft and tonal.
avoid: Avoid black leather here — stay in the warm brown lane.

name: Noir & Indigo
why: Black deconstructed overshirt over relaxed indigo; chelsea boots sharpen the off-duty line.
avoid: Avoid black jeans — indigo gives the black depth.

name: Écru Structuré
why: Ecru linen softens the navy wool coat; black trousers and derbies mean business — 3 deep-autumn-safe tones.
avoid: Avoid a grey blazer swap — navy is warmer and richer on deep autumn.

name: Double Denim Foncé
why: Dark-indigo shirt over mid-indigo jeans is tonal denim done right; brown oxfords add autumn warmth.
avoid: Avoid matching washes exactly — keep the two indigos clearly different.

name: Graphique Charbon
why: Charcoal graphic tee under black bomber with indigo — muted, moody, deep-autumn street.
avoid: Avoid light-wash denim — it breaks the dark palette.

name: Jean Noir, Nuit
why: Black denim overshirt with distressed indigo and brown oxfords — rugged texture for a low-key date.
avoid: Avoid black trousers — indigo keeps the black from going flat.

name: Gris sous le Noir
why: Ribbed grey tank under a relaxed black blazer; chelsea boots make the layered tank club-ready.
avoid: Avoid grey trousers — too much grey kills the contrast.

name: Blanc Cassé
why: White tank + white trousers as a tonal base; ecru jacket softens the white near face, brown oxfords ground it.
avoid: Avoid skipping the jacket — stark white alone washes out deep autumn.

name: Ribbed & Relaxed
why: Grey ribbed tank under an open black overshirt; distressed indigo keeps it firmly off-duty.
avoid: Avoid club context — distressed denim stays daytime.

name: Hoodie Habillé
why: Navy hoodie with white pleated trousers and a brown derby — high-low Parisian casual, deep-autumn safe.
avoid: Avoid sneakers or joggers — tailored trousers keep it out of gym territory.

name: Henley d'Automne
why: White henley warmed by mid-indigo denim and brown oxfords — a simple 3-color casual uniform.
avoid: Avoid stark-white overload — the brown leather must stay close to warm the face.

name: Pop Royal
why: Royal-blue tee as the single accent; black trousers, grey-marl blazer and derbies keep the look deep.
avoid: Avoid a second bright color — one pop only, everything else dark.
